title: EVP Assets - Pyrotechnician
description: Optional assets for Pyrotechnician villager profession
body:
Optional assets for [EVP - Pyrotechnician](https://modrinth.com/datapack/evp-pyrotechnician).

Includes texture and lang files.

<details>
<summary>Supported languages:</summary>

- \*all english variations\* _(implied, fallback)_
- ar_sa (Arabic)
- de_de (German)
- es_es (Spanish)
- fr_fr (French)
- it_it (Italian)
- ja_jp (Japanese)
- ko_kr (Korean)
- ru_ru (Russian)
- zh_cn (Chinese)

</details>

**Requires [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures). Otherwise textures wont work!**

![Minecraft Villager in a full-body leather suit and an iron helmet with visor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31be97499fe44b9d01b7b880cb6a78b352a45fab.png)
